# Cloudflare One SASE migration planner

Honest caveats: a planning and assessment methodology, not an automatic migrator — it fetches current Cloudflare docs, API schemas and vendor export docs before generating exact configuration; you supply the source-platform exports and a Cloudflare account; no policy is ever created or enabled without your review; the assessment template and the "never create broad allow-all catchalls" rule are the guardrails. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
